Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestUtcInstant_factory_parse_CharSequence_invalid.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestUtcInstant/TestUtcInstant_factory_parse_CharSequence_invalid.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original test file carries a large amount of dead code — five unused data providers and a helper method that have nothing to do with the single parameterized test actually run. Let me write a focused, readable version.Compiles cleanly. I removed the five unused data providers (`data_withModifiedJulianDay`, `data_withNanoOfDay`, `data_plus`, `data_minus`, `data_toString`), the unused `doTest_comparisons_UtcInstant` helper, and a pile of unused constants/imports — leaving only the single parameterized parse test with clarifying comments on each bad input. Behavior is unchanged: the same three inputs are passed to `UtcInstant.parse` expecting `DateTimeException`.
